name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: WHO reported one fatal Shamonda virus case in France on 2 Nov; no unexplained cluster under investigation
state: WHO reported on 2 Nov the first documented human infection with Shamonda virus, a known animal virus, in an older man in eastern France who died on 8 Oct; no further human cases have been found and contacts are being tested (WHO). It is a single case of an identified pathogen, not a cluster. Searches to 15 Nov found no unexplained cluster under international investigation, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No unexplained outbreak currently affects the public. Travellers can check UKHSA and WHO outbreak updates and FCDO travel advice for any destination-specific health warnings.
rubric_hit: Normal: no unexplained clusters under international investigation (single Shamonda case, France, 2 Nov)
